d: Public place in Rome, by solemn oaths, with statue of Pluto, and Proserpina. At the sound of symphony of various instruments are Tito Manlio, Manlio, Vitellia, Lucio, Servilia, Decius, Soldiers and People.
Apartments in Vitellia in the palace of Tito. Vitellia and Lindo.
Latin camp. Geminio with Tuscan Knights.
Lindo leaves. Manlio survives with Roman Knights.
Geminio and Manlio, who observes Servilia leaving.
Room in Tito's palace. Tito, and Lucio.
Vitellia, running to Tito, Lucio, and then Servilia.
Decius with Officers, and sayings, then Manlio comes.
Courtyard with Geminio's grave, Lindo and Vitellia.
Come in Decius with Officers carrying chains.
Decius goes to Titus, who writes the sentence, he sees him saying:
Manlio. Lucio who comes over reading, Servilia in the background.
Room in Tito's palace, Lindo and Vitellia.
Lucio, then Tito and Servilia come.
Public place in Rome. Vitellia and Lindo.
Manlio, Lucio, Soldier, Littori, and sayings.
Decius comes in with the armed Phalanxes, and sayings.
